notes.title: Turn your TTRPG campaign up to 11 with custom music playlists!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've been working hard these last few months adding a couple of highly requested features to Conclave.

[previewyoutube=UB4Kew_v0mY;full][/previewyoutube]

First up: custom playlists. You can import mp3 files into Conclave and create custom playlists within your scenes. You can even have multiple, in case you want both music and ambient sounds at the same time (or maybe you want the chaos of multiple songs playing all at once; that's cool too, we don't judge).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/914efb13c00e29f6bead50816bfab6759abd3a1e.gif[/img]

Also in this update: STAMPS. GMs and players alike often need to mark important locations and key items on the map, and now you can (googly eyes not included). Move, rotate, and scale, then stick 'em to a map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/724cb48f7b53588c09d7f1fa6a8a541325d63639.png[/img]

We love hearing about what ya'll want from a VTT; if you've got ideas for features you'd like to see in Conclave, let us know on here, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ConclaveVTT/]Reddit[/url], or our [url=https://discord.gg/YhsTJmu]Discord[/url]. We're so glad to get to be a part of your table. Thanks so much for checking out Conclave VTT!

notes.title: Get Conclave Virtual Tabletop for 20% off During Remote Play Together Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello, we're excited to announce that Conclave Virtual Tabletop is part of Steam's Remote Play Together Fest, which is happening right now! From now until February 19th, you can get Conclave VTT for 20% off.

Steam Remote Play Together allows local multiplayer games to be played with friends remotely, and with just one copy of the game. We designed Conclave Virtual Tabletop to take advantage of Remote Play Together and other screen sharing services to provide an easy and accessible way to play your TTRPG campaign with friends near and far, with just a click of a button.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay_together]Steam’s Remote Play Together Fest runs from February 12th to the 19th, and includes demos and discounts for participating games.[/url]

You can keep up with all the latest Conclave updates by following us here, or joining our [url=https://discord.com/invite/YhsTJmu]Discord.[/url]

Thanks so much!

notes.title: What's New in Conclave Virtual Tabletop
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It's now been 2 months since Conclave Virtual Tabletop released and we want to thank all of you for your support. We truly appreciate getting to be a part of your table :) I wanted to do a quick post to share some of the updates that have come to Conclave since launch.

...Starting with *TUTORIALS*.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/1b14427d1fda32422e449a2b724249849a9178b4.png[/img]

While we strive to make our UI and tools easy to understand and use, we realized we missed the mark early on by not including tutorials. You'll now find 12 tutorials (featuring text and video clips) that highlight everything from basic controls, to importing your Hero Forge library, to playing with others using Steam Remote Play Together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/a805741289342ed7a7772c6c404f84437ff8a491.png[/img]

Just a quick note on these, though: they are currently only in English. We're aiming to include translations for other languages soon.

Conclave Virtual Tabletop is designed for use with Steam Remote Play Together and other desktop streaming services, which allows your entire group to play using just one copy of Conclave. However, something we did not anticipate before launch was that if bad actors were connected to your game, they could potentially see your files by using Conclave's asset import tools. To combat this, Conclave now has a session password feature that you can set at startup, or at any time using the Preferences menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/d7543128b73f775071acddb4269de3cc9c367533.png[/img]

Enabling a session password will result in a password prompt appearing anytime you or another player attempts to import assets into Conclave. Be aware that the session password is reset when you close the game.

While many desktop streaming services can work for Conclave Virtual Tabletop, we want to reiterate that we recommend using Steam Remote Play Together for this, as it will ensure that players are not able to see anything on the host's computer outside of the game itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/c8300a1fdbc2b8dcd57dcd9cfa8337dfbe56097d.png[/img]

Besides the usual bug fixes, we're also committed to adding new tools to help facilitate play. When using the Grab tool, you can now toggle group selection to move multiple figures at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/1f23914bcca885de49eb3e6a839f88d9dec5eb71.png[/img]

That's all for now, but you can join our Discord server and follow us on social media for the latest Conclave updates, or to report any issues you might run into :) Thanks again!

notes.title: 🎲 Roll into National Dice Day with Conclave Virtual Tabletop, Available Now!
notes.notes:
It's December 4th, which means a) it is [i]NATIONAL DICE DAY[/i], and b) Conclave Virtual Tabletop is available now on Steam!

Here's the Launch Trailer for your viewing pleasure: 

[previewyoutube=ydc3ktrE3bk;full][/previewyoutube]

I originally built Conclave for my own weekly game, before expanding it into something we could publish on Steam... And now it's finally happened. I cannot tell you how much I appreciate all of your support and encouragement! 

Reviews, wishlists, and follows help us out [b]A TON[/b] (especially reviews), as would sharing this with anyone you know that you think might enjoy it. Please also consider dropping by our[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FYhsTJmu] Discord community[/url], if you haven't already.

Seriously, thanks so much! We're looking forward to seeing what you all think of Conclave :)

notes.title: Conclave Virtual Tabletop Releases December 4th! Free Goodies Available Now
notes.notes:
It's a big week for Conclave Virtual Tabletop. We're excited to finally announce our release date: [b]December 4th, 2023[/b]! That's just under two months away (and, fittingly, is also [i][b]National Dice Day[/b][/i]).

While we've still got some time to go until launch, you can actually try Conclave for yourself [b]RIGHT NOW[/b]. As part of Steam Next Fest, we've released a 30-minute demo of Conclave that allows you to test nearly every feature, so you can see if Conclave is a good fit for your party. Please try it out and let us know what you think!

In case that still wasn't enough, we've also got a free goodie for GMs or other chronic note-takers (and note-misplacers). We've just released a free campaign and worldbuilding template, powered by Notion. It's what we use to structure our own weekly 5e game, and can be used regardless of whether you play online or in-person, with Conclave or without. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/a7ac59bd13b4de390100e390a8fc2a74edbe8183.png[/img]

Our template comes in desktop and mobile flavors, and includes sections for creatures, factions, lairs, magic items, shops and more. It can also be used for encounter tracking, session notes, providing handouts and idea generation. It's just a little something we wanted to share with our favorite community <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/2c16a9a2ef69308b6290a761ff42b590694dcc13.png[/img]

[url=https://conclavedm.notion.site/Campaign-Worldbuilding-Template-84b14198994143fdb2ee74ff7ad48304?pvs=4]Campaign Template (desktop version)[/url]
[url=https://conclavedm.notion.site/Campaign-Template-Mobile-82b6f786b02a4456af6122e522577f18?pvs=4]Campaign Template (mobile version)[/url]

Thanks so much for all your support.

-Brandon

notes.title: Conclave Virtual Tabletop: Special 5e One-Shot
notes.notes:
Brynn, Ember, and Rosco arrive at Rundelstrom Academy to challenge their infamous Mage Tower team in order to win back a stolen artifact. This previously-recorded one-shot was played using Conclave Virtual Tabletop, and features characters and stories from our weekly 5e game. We hope you enjoy! 

Conclave Virtual Tabletop launches later this year, and you can try out the special demo right now during Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: Bring Your Digital Minis to Conclave VTT With the Hero Forge® Access Key
notes.notes:
We are incredibly excited to share the news that Conclave Virtual Tabletop will support the Hero Forge® Access Key at launch! Right from the start, you'll be able to access your library of Hero Forge® digital miniatures and bring them to life in full, glorious 3D!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/21dc80d93fb777ec15ebb65676b5949e6d3f7662.gif[/img]

Not only can you use the minis you've designed yourself, but by connecting your account you'll unlock access to five free minis. You'll always have an adventuring party ready to go!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/8a78f575e2d76bf26e1947e8fb93dfe9830e0102.png[/img]

You can be among the first to try Conclave Virtual Tabletop during Steam Next Fest in October. We'll have a demo available showing off all of our core features and tools, including Hero Forge® access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152247/152ecc130acd83879c326fc0be3fe4f7bea9d331.gif[/img]

Conclave Virtual Tabletop launches later this year. Wishlist now if you haven't already, and we'll see you at Next Fest!
